# Verification plan: [change or specification]

For spec-driven work, run focused tests/checks for the active slice and record evidence before starting the next slice. Run the full test suite after all slices are complete unless an accepted spec amendment or project agreement requires an earlier full run. Complete one adversarial review against the full spec and final diff at the end, using a strong model if available or the engineer-run review skill otherwise.
